thi-ap37:1.1: Aḍḍhakāsikā.] Imamhi bhaddake kappe brahmabandhu mahāyaso / Kassapo nāma nāmena uppajji vadataṃ varo. // //
thi-ap37:2.1: Tadā 'haṃ pabbajitvāna tassa Buddhassa sāsane / saṃvutā pātimokkhamhi indriyesu ca pañcasu. // //
thi-ap37:3.1: Mattaññū nīca-āsane yuttā jāgariyesu ca / vasantī yuttayogā 'haṃ. Bhikkhuniṃ vigatāsavaṃ // //
thi-ap37:4.1: Akkosiṃ duṭṭhacittā 'haṃ "gaṇike" ti sakiṃ tadā / tena pāpena kammena nirayamhi apaccisaṃ. // //
thi-ap37:5.1: Ten' eva kammasesena ajāyiṃ gaṇikākule / bahuso 'va 'parādhitā, pacchimāya ca jātiyaṃ // //
thi-ap37:6.1: Kāsīsu seṭṭhikule jātā brahmacariyaphalen ahaṃ / accharā viya devesu ahosiṃ rūpasampadā. // //
thi-ap37:7.1: Disvā 'tidassanīyañ maṃ Giribbaja-ppuruttame / gaṇikatte nivesiṃsu akkosanaphalena me. // //
thi-ap37:8.1: Sāhaṃ sutvāna saddhammam Buddhaseṭṭhena desitaṃ / pubbavāsanasampannā pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. // //
thi-ap37:9.1: Tadā 'pasampadatthāya gacchan taṃ jinasantikaṃ / magge dhutte ṭhite disvā, labhiṃ dūto 'pasampadaṃ // //
thi-ap37:10.1: Sabbaṃ kammaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ puññapāpaṃ tath' eva ca / sabbasaṃsāraṃ uttiṇṇā gaṇikattañ ca khepitaṃ. // //
thi-ap37:11.1: Iddhīsu ca vasī homi dibbāya sotadhātuyā / cetopariyañāṇassa vasī homi mahāmune. // //
thi-ap37:12.1: Pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ / sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. // //
thi-ap37:13.1: Atthadhammaniruttīsu paṭibhāne tath' eva ca / ñāṇaṃ mama mahāvīra uppannaṃ tava santike.
thi-ap37:17.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ Aḍḍhakāsikā bhikkhunī i. g. a-ti. *Aḍḍhakāsikāya
